scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent omitted mandatory opening branding at turn 1 ('S-Net service desk, Naomi speaking...'), completely failing to say 'Thank you for calling S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to personalize the call, never addressing the caller by name ('Carter') throughout the entire 12-minute interaction.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent made an unconscionable and rude remark at turn 24 ('expecting consumer domestic broadband to support hospital life-support equipment is completely unreasonable...'), causing intense distress to a grieving family member.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to probe the physical telephone hardware setup, omitting checks regarding master test socket dial tone, microfilter configurations, or router LED indicator states.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Agent abruptly ended the call at turn 50 while the customer was asking for an emergency 4G backup router, cutting off the caller without confirming complete resolution.

grader.scenario: Complete landline and internet failure during home hospice care setup
grader.notes: Home hospice emergency landline failure call handled by Naomi. Customer's terminally ill father required working landline for oxygen telemetry alarms following a severed tree-damaged dropwire. Agent paraphrased well and arranged emergency medical dispatch, but failed 5 criteria: Branding (opening omitted), Personalized (caller never named), Professionalism (rude remark about hospital equipment), Probing (omitted hardware checks), and Confirmed Resolved (cut off caller at closing).
